AIDisclosureStrings.ToastBody: This island has AI-powered non-playable characters (NPCs) that you can talk to. Consider taking a break whenever you need one.

Dialogue.F794D1CA490806C0138AF1A7B7ED6EE9_D328ABF: A new morning has risen. Please wake up, everyone.
Dialogue.701D30CD49D2E4BA097CDE9365BD7E1F_D328ABF: All players, please line up with your teammates at the entrance of the gamehall
Dialogue.F814EE0C4C651CCD55C1EE81740930DC_D328ABF: All workers, please return to your rooms.
Dialogue.45AAC80A4544150B0AD1A7AF80B4871B_D328ABF: Failure to follow the rules will result in elimination
Dialogue.3698C929416B5344D336E3AAC259FC91_D328ABF: For the Final game, you'll both be playing Squid Game
Dialogue.FF07913A4547E84B11089DA2A1D37172_1B31EE2: Oh yeah. To the left a little.
Dialogue.B521936E47B13656156B03977F77F753_D328ABF: Players, please enter the game area
Dialogue.10ACEF694728A7FA8994DE9B6F158539_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the eighth game
Dialogue.085E48F5461C1CC55E518D83AD7DDA1D_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the fifth game
Dialogue.DAFE14DA4788FE8512A84EA627252135_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the final game
Dialogue.02E1FC9D463DA6EA3FF691BC63617AF5_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the first game
Dialogue.62133E944B5EE3CAA8DFB29761A1534B_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the fourth game
Dialogue.3CD1DB854422B0DB2C681BBA89CFB73D_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the ninth game
Dialogue.C2F004154620D14D427C968C92494757_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the second game
Dialogue.3FC3F65A4E93382752019BB8114E18FC_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the seventh game
Dialogue.4601DA594C5DF46B5FEDD499D3C3E368_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the sixth game
Dialogue.AC09440D44075D9EE9EF44AFDA7E1051_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the tenth game
Dialogue.19F0597B462D19F70FADE0BDB193DF94_03D678C: Players, welcome to the third game
Dialogue.F0F59F394C9107F95DA913825FA1479B_D328ABF: Players, welcome to the third game
Dialogue.B9B6ADC844EA8B19591BB6B0FBDFDAE2_D328ABF: The time for finding a partner is now over
Dialogue.75AB441249D1616F33981B871F807518_D328ABF: The time for forming your teams is over
Dialogue.29EC0D2F48BAD2D103A8BA8A841290CB_D328ABF: The work schedule is done for today.
Dialogue.B671D4C34C431EC8FFF8F7A334490596_D328ABF: With that, let the game begin
Dialogue.C7178FED476DFA3DD735F6AB16CBE379_69FC6EE: You have successfully made it through the final game.
Dialogue.49134D364E2537CA618667A0BCCE96E9_2FE2A84: Zadie: (low laugh) So clean it was filthy.
Dialogue.F67E21454DE8AEB95FE9EA8D51702CB6_2FE2A84: Zadie: (low laugh) So clean it was filthy.
Dialogue.C9D1408847954D15476F798ACCB87CE2_2FE2A84: Zadie: (low laugh). Stage lights are on. Don't freeze.
Dialogue.D81AED13415711A1C3007F83D709A9B6_2FE2A84: Zadie: A giant fell. You didn't even blink an eye. Ruthless.
Dialogue.34AAD7E749CC0F42E1B4A8BA4F3D735D_2FE2A84: Zadie: Actually, that might be entertaining.
Dialogue.DC5F7975472D2C6D0D2B708D952235AE_2FE2A84: Zadie: Again. I see a pattern emerging.
Dialogue.284EA324432663B63173A59574E5D2A2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Another victory... I've got my eye on you.
Dialogue.16F21C284ACCF271764446AF93D60B92_2FE2A84: Zadie: Are you a builder, a tactician, or a weapons specialist?
Dialogue.E64A9DB24DF5C13E5E563DB0AEF3DE3E_2FE2A84: Zadie: Arena's live. Make it count.
Dialogue.63DBC72B43BE4F55E4D9AE920841C589_2FE2A84: Zadie: Ask cleaner questions and maybe you'll get cleaner answers.
Dialogue.885D6FC24C3D1590C33E0F81CAFD0458_2FE2A84: Zadie: Be the reason they forfeit.
Dialogue.7AAF14414C88A6A210180499D8464BCB_2FE2A84: Zadie: Channel it. Rage is wasted if it doesn't aim.
Dialogue.33B801E34E68FD98E63F8E96825C617C_2FE2A84: Zadie: Close it out, or watch it slip away.
Dialogue.FEC9428B40136A20E6C33CBE8188D21D_2FE2A84: Zadie: Close it out, or watch it slip away.
Dialogue.79816E9144F3D698750E86B77A31B53C_2FE2A84: Zadie: Come back when you've earned it.
Dialogue.80068BFB43630CDC84D90A8FCC4C33A4_2FE2A84: Zadie: Come find me on the island.
Dialogue.A807543E4C3EAFD7CBEF64AE4883B686_2FE2A84: Zadie: Consider this a live evaluation.
Dialogue.85C0B6B64071826ADE823793785C7C32_2FE2A84: Zadie: Consistency will be the key.
Dialogue.7A95402A47E07DEBE915BBA9294F9C87_2FE2A84: Zadie: Don't coast on your success. Stay sharp.
Dialogue.74B4AE574BBC13CA0ACA5A81A5EFAC4A_2FE2A84: Zadie: Don't let off the gas.
Dialogue.77D8109E472195CE1CA21FB5E6132879_2FE2A84: Zadie: Don't take your foot off the gas.
Dialogue.BCFEF9594CA6A7D8D26BBC8906AE33E2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Effortless, as it should be.
Dialogue.2152083A4C28AAE33BD3D7BD908269F9_2FE2A84: Zadie: Enjoy your winning streak... while it lasts.
Dialogue.249612F5454A969F2BF378BACD640FB0_2FE2A84: Zadie: Entry is a privilege. Consider what that means for you.
Dialogue.3D01EA034A4BCB4892C3888C456ABC4B_2FE2A84: Zadie: Everyone wants to be Elite.
Dialogue.088168CD4A87D10C5C8C8FA95837E453_2FE2A84: Zadie: Excellence is the only invitation.
Dialogue.360B53504B0EA9B917DBB4893B6B13B8_2FE2A84: Zadie: Find me on starter island.
Dialogue.D20301CA471800DDD5D7DA9555AC6CBA_2FE2A84: Zadie: Gifted, and still learning not to flex I see.
Dialogue.584787454D0C5178553652B2AA011E80_2FE2A84: Zadie: Glory is in your grasp.
Dialogue.8755C6A94A5C86C4D1982A8BD97118E2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Good. But is it your best?
Dialogue.A0D1CD674C1F0DA9E468E9BB8E80CF20_2FE2A84: Zadie: Half-measures get half results. Commit.
Dialogue.1085B0464F39BCE51E529EB0DEB1A960_2FE2A84: Zadie: Heading in the right direction. Don't detour.
Dialogue.F8689D874EC2340413D6D18C11095EC2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Hmph. Didn't script that outcome.
Dialogue.BEA2B0C34B216B513D0D8294E0473B8F_2FE2A84: Zadie: Hot streak...they end just as quickly for the careless.
Dialogue.61CA64824236BF428E139FB555B9B6DF_2FE2A84: Zadie: Hunger beats talent that quit early.
Dialogue.ACBB8FE5435F3F99051DBAB2FA61540F_2FE2A84: Zadie: Hunger beats talent that quit early.
Dialogue.B9F42604482F14A339B7C19454AD3CCB_2FE2A84: Zadie: I file special assignments for people like you.
Dialogue.E56382A54F3D00C9B344A99A0B4B969F_2FE2A84: Zadie: I found him tiresome... until I watched him hunt.
Dialogue.D50AEEA54C436BCA2DB778AE5DB259B1_2FE2A84: Zadie: I had some dealings with Kado Thorne in my Imagined Order days.
Dialogue.3EA9B27B49806766DBBCE3810EB4D93D_2FE2A84: Zadie: I know there's more in the tank.
Dialogue.12F8786842D3A5E774A5BBBB447848FB_2FE2A84: Zadie: I respect a hard target. I prefer a finished one.
Dialogue.E9EE4D8641B2953C629981A8BCFE2891_2FE2A84: Zadie: I saw Ice King move better than that. And where is he now?
Dialogue.DD7D3CDD4792EF55B3E4B1BCEDF32F93_2FE2A84: Zadie: I saw Ice King move better than that. Where is he now?
Dialogue.11100E1D44707F67072F58805B049732_2FE2A84: Zadie: I see flashes. I hire finishers.
Dialogue.622988104450DF58626E98A1F269CBE8_2FE2A84: Zadie: I wouldn't wanna see Geno and Kado Thorne in the same room.
Dialogue.E1DEDCF2414494CC4CFFD599ED844F8E_2FE2A84: Zadie: I'll keep my eye on you.
Dialogue.93F6349A44EFB569299A6D88B0BA526C_2FE2A84: Zadie: I'm here for this show. Keep it up.
Dialogue.055BFC2B4C09615D2ABCEAAB478D0C01_2FE2A84: Zadie: I'm not running a friendship circle.
Dialogue.7028CDFE4F374256F26A08A420E95424_2FE2A84: Zadie: I've wanted to recruit Kado Thorne for a very long time.
Dialogue.97E30A6F40C3442B1700B9B4FB3D4606_2FE2A84: Zadie: I've wanted to recruit Kado Thorne for a very long time.
Dialogue.77C5E8A6414D8DE6F43C77836A3706CC_2FE2A84: Zadie: If you're seeking redemption, you're useless to me. Seek greatness.
Dialogue.2670C477413766228F7AA8AA89C6E472_2FE2A84: Zadie: If you're standing in my halls, I expect output.
Dialogue.88376758437C310E819DC58284009AED_2FE2A84: Zadie: Impress me, then we'll talk.
Dialogue.DA43189A42F8738D0AD44497B274905A_2FE2A84: Zadie: Interesting file. Still missing pages.
Dialogue.DB456FC5495341E95110799D0A1000C1_2FE2A84: Zadie: Jules and Kado Thorne give each other plenty of space. Fair.
Dialogue.327EF1B74E4F7F2113FBBAB27EA75B13_2FE2A84: Zadie: Kado Thorne embraces what he is. That's why I respect him.
Dialogue.E5EB63F64FC0CB77E5E0FEAEE099C91F_2FE2A84: Zadie: Kado's hunting for prey, but I'm hunting for predators.
Dialogue.41B64A9148CF1CBC76B5C3A9B66E7CF5_2FE2A84: Zadie: Keep this up and I might be impressed.
Dialogue.D4E0E7E144454C85A4D2F4BA60DBD620_2FE2A84: Zadie: Keep this up and I'll be impressed.
Dialogue.409E9C2E406E70D8EEBBD3ADAB42C276_2FE2A84: Zadie: Keep this up and you will be chosen.
Dialogue.F553557745919FDC0B720F84F43059DE_2FE2A84: Zadie: Keep this up and you will be chosen.
Dialogue.F0766EBC4ECD8B14A1B308946536BD25_2FE2A84: Zadie: Keep your foot on the gas.
Dialogue.341CEBAC42AAAD1A02BC25A723FBECFE_2FE2A84: Zadie: Let's see what you can do.
Dialogue.7F6025F049D64895F839AD8C3B0D8CC6_2FE2A84: Zadie: Looked like luck to me. Make 'em regret it.
Dialogue.1CACE9E446C8D36BF7C8C5949674D26B_2FE2A84: Zadie: Losses teach. Quits bury the lesson.
Dialogue.8B48E85F414651F937721EB93F4B23F7_2FE2A84: Zadie: Losses teach. Quits bury the lesson.
Dialogue.E2F100CA452A0D05A6F7A1B708EEB672_2FE2A84: Zadie: Meet me where we build the future of The Elites.
Dialogue.D1FC821C4601B5F96E323BB201267B20_2FE2A84: Zadie: Monstrosity is power. And The Elites respect power.
Dialogue.3D6941184EFBA13109BB2E88FD4F93A9_2FE2A84: Zadie: Move on. Rewrite the next fight.
Dialogue.6028584A4960C8476E37398D271019BD_2FE2A84: Zadie: My scouts don't waste my time. Neither should you.
Dialogue.50CE275F4B759DD1A7C6DF9593BE9E87_2FE2A84: Zadie: My time isn't a participation trophy.
Dialogue.199D7CF34B3324A214A468AE5F6A2B0D_2FE2A84: Zadie: No IO. No Seven. The Elites stand alone.
Dialogue.0CFE45714771EB03B4FED78B19F091EC_2FE2A84: Zadie: No one can buy my mercy.
Dialogue.0EE9909F4186808C41EAA2A0B46C1E3C_2FE2A84: Zadie: No one can buy my mercy.
Dialogue.F6F52EE4481F5D1D4DC638A05F3CB767_2FE2A84: Zadie: No scrimmages here. This is your chance.
Dialogue.64C0E3024F1552F21AD2EA9BEAF32A99_2FE2A84: Zadie: No second guesses. It's yours now.
Dialogue.9B4A456B430A2E81F102DAB5292D8424_2FE2A84: Zadie: No second guesses. It's yours now.
Dialogue.44019AEE4553A2A100C1558FE5151ECB_2FE2A84: Zadie: Nobody invades my house twice.
Dialogue.8F1EE6B74F9B56870086F2972AE59F2D_2FE2A84: Zadie: Nothin' beats the sound of a reboot.
Dialogue.6962A9264E90B9A1C520949039963A0B_2FE2A84: Zadie: Only the best earn their place among the Elite.
Dialogue.90D7412E4A25DADF054756BB63D5DEFF_2FE2A84: Zadie: Oof. Put 'em in the dirt!
Dialogue.81CB188248F0AC3254851D9727841A85_2FE2A84: Zadie: Oof.. put them in the dirt.
Dialogue.A27340344A5454855AFD1F99FF8E46A5_2FE2A84: Zadie: Our base is secured. Operations resume.
Dialogue.6AD950B345458BA6A167448FC93F57C2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Packed 'em up and shipped 'em out.
Dialogue.CF0DA00146441A9EA44F45A39F95AD40_2FE2A84: Zadie: Play like it's the last spot on the roster.
Dialogue.39CE04C240F17C42D568938CA312451D_2FE2A84: Zadie: Put that one in the archives.
Dialogue.A14EB90546CC41501E8153BF15AC57AC_2FE2A84: Zadie: Quiet satisfaction is still satisfaction.
Dialogue.2475570A4EFF3AC42C3C14908F5C3F4B_2FE2A84: Zadie: Reality 337 isn't on any map. Yet he still found a way... There must be loose ends.
Dialogue.BDF10D674AD6C0A07AF5ACA73F1DBCF6_2FE2A84: Zadie: Reality 337 isn't on any map. Yet he still found a way... There must be loose ends.
Dialogue.DC8B8CDF42F4B464374807811021E68D_2FE2A84: Zadie: Rebuild from the mistake, not the ego.
Dialogue.428D07ED4479C7E27AF86BA5F3E7F2DE_2FE2A84: Zadie: Roster material... pending a few more wars.
Dialogue.674EC3A444A7AC7D1E95AC9AB0BEAC9A_2FE2A84: Zadie: Round locked. You wrote it.
Dialogue.528A7EA649911DF4CB1894A74454A164_2FE2A84: Zadie: Shake it off. Next loadouts up.
Dialogue.09D9A1334538BD3DD6FDE8B5978B48A9_2FE2A84: Zadie: Show me you can do this again. And again.
Dialogue.2E3AEDC8429FF5050A3AA5B4C109F1FA_2FE2A84: Zadie: Skill is the only resume I read.
Dialogue.8307B1FD40F75CBF432F7780C93E0BE0_2FE2A84: Zadie: Skill is the only resume I read.
Dialogue.7EA9622F4E99C5D3AA0A7793C59841A2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Smooth. Almost insulting how easy you make it.
Dialogue.2BB21F754AEA041C44448082A407069E_2FE2A84: Zadie: Steady now... don't get cute.
Dialogue.AACC82E8439FE2F9A9E4918D4D7C08B2_2FE2A84: Zadie: Step in. Show me a reason to care.
Dialogue.B1FA44C7419E20341646AEA46300B7A6_2FE2A84: Zadie: Step in. Show me a reason to care.
Dialogue.69728D5F4F43CB8B17CB5C99F48A2EE7_2FE2A84: Zadie: That makes three... well played.
Dialogue.FA2F78C246F0E5948C1C60A3104B6ED5_2FE2A84: Zadie: That play'll haunt their dreams.
Dialogue.D80AD506460E9BBF2A7C4F8C59E1C7F8_2FE2A84: Zadie: That right there is how you eliminate.
Dialogue.E82017814257455D1139238C13E811A3_2FE2A84: Zadie: That round's dead. You aren't.
Dialogue.98E473854F512210B75E8E8BA87BF703_2FE2A84: Zadie: That was it right there.
Dialogue.64C792164F523FF9B96851BB900031FE_2FE2A84: Zadie: That's how you stack 'em up.
Dialogue.54F6EDEF4CCF4C6FCB3876BBCA3C1A5D_2FE2A84: Zadie: The Elites are always watching...
Dialogue.E187DE7349B82397E86722BC6FF03E6D_2FE2A84: Zadie: The IO taught me how empires fail from the inside.
Dialogue.ACDB07DC438E0F8D5774258A87863A27_2FE2A84: Zadie: The battlefield is yours to control.
Dialogue.90B2CF1C44C6E34604A1A690FEC6146A_2FE2A84: Zadie: The clock's a weapon. Use it.
Dialogue.0D14039143BD9F10A9408E9902FED44A_2FE2A84: Zadie: The others would be wise to learn from you.
Dialogue.1AB3A57045CCEF40D33F719C75372956_2FE2A84: Zadie: The spotlight found you. Hold it, or lose it.
Dialogue.0A48A23643CFFE3B53FA418ACCBA788D_2FE2A84: Zadie: The stronghold awaits. Don't waste the invite.
Dialogue.3E5BCD5543A7BC2A63DFEEA456A9CC0C_2FE2A84: Zadie: There's a seat in the room if you keep this up.
Dialogue.8E22DFB94ABC7D401CDE9885DAB50043_2FE2A84: Zadie: There's the Elites and then there's everybody else.
Dialogue.661EA91C405B5C53BFA470B69F3B9438_2FE2A84: Zadie: They brought talk. You brought action.
Dialogue.579C032B4410C7FADA8B30AC80AF8ECC_2FE2A84: Zadie: They crumbled... you make it look simple.
Dialogue.BE3E827C43733E2B74F12AA5CC83A63D_2FE2A84: Zadie: They're both vicious, arrogant, territorial, power-hungry...
Dialogue.C80CFC3C48E01459C887ACBDC251D635_2FE2A84: Zadie: They're studying you now. Good.
Dialogue.F7F58E7A46528CD91D2746AB76AD3515_2FE2A84: Zadie: This is your chance to prove yourself.
Dialogue.5AD7273B45D759828EDA1D93EBFB59E8_2FE2A84: Zadie: This place chews through almosts.
Dialogue.8A4C625B4F02C2D8981A3185EBC167CC_2FE2A84: Zadie: Those who don't impress us in the hunt... they're all yours.
Dialogue.41261D1A48136B5659FF60833B094F39_2FE2A84: Zadie: Tilt is a choice. Choose better.
Dialogue.2C4FB5764CFA6A499D3101B247FD60AA_2FE2A84: Zadie: To be elite is to master the art of battle.
Dialogue.35DA06AF435A9E79A67CEA9BF2950FEA_2FE2A84: Zadie: Trust me. He belongs among The Elites.
Dialogue.3150D8CC4BF15D1BE74766A44F3D55CD_2FE2A84: Zadie: Until the offer lands, stay lethal.
Dialogue.E54FE0F6469F69BA21C39CAB3AE31A14_2FE2A84: Zadie: Up your game, then we'll talk.
Dialogue.E9F9925D4B8CDFEF0EC01DA2002DB809_2FE2A84: Zadie: Up your game, then we'll talk.
Dialogue.C4AAD6994E4F39F642322FB2A2EBECA4_2FE2A84: Zadie: Victory. Number. Three. Ha. Flawless.
Dialogue.B9CC19B24D0FAB36221BE4BA1226F992_2FE2A84: Zadie: We can chat when your record does the talking.
Dialogue.F300E2A04163CA830953FF96F8BA7BE2_2FE2A84: Zadie: We only want the best of the best.
Dialogue.9351E50541EE51C59528868CC3CAC6B9_2FE2A84: Zadie: When the right contract drops, you'll hear from me first.
Dialogue.F4FD53A74BE50CF879F883920D258E52_2FE2A84: Zadie: Word travels of your accomplishments.
Dialogue.13B02C1948D0CF3CAD693FA94F50D90E_2FE2A84: Zadie: You always find an advantage. Well done.
Dialogue.F4BB44044E5376D217E33E8ACB02DF12_2FE2A84: Zadie: You build with speed and clarity...
Dialogue.B0FB3001419B0AF0B1C56F92CC25D3D5_2FE2A84: Zadie: You didn't come here to sightsee.
Dialogue.05264BC84FEDCBC469C3E28F61B9F066_2FE2A84: Zadie: You just jumped a few names on my list.
Dialogue.6715572242F787C0105720838CC61277_2FE2A84: Zadie: You keep racking rounds like this, I'll take notes.
Dialogue.239B32E14296D211D66F67A95C1ACD4C_2FE2A84: Zadie: You met Mongraal? He's the one we tap to silence entire armies.
Dialogue.A161759E4FC0CC61655FD3AD73514DA4_2FE2A84: Zadie: You met Mongraal? Hmph. He's the one we tap to silence entire armies.
Dialogue.89E872154E15019E068C5A983DA1610D_2FE2A84: Zadie: You're a legend. But that doesn't mean anything if you're not useful to me.
Dialogue.575B8C44419250D917B96DBB515794D2_2FE2A84: Zadie: You're carving a path. Keep the blade sharp.
Dialogue.F4D492D64BCAA12CA087DCBC42D48551_2FE2A84: Zadie: You're gaining quite a reputation.
Dialogue.ACD317C34D3CB4C8945DE29A5DA9877E_2FE2A84: Zadie: You're on a run. Don't let arrogance best you.
Dialogue.8EC6962945FFDF73B3574CBF72252792_2FE2A84: Zadie: You're responsible for our defenses. You know what to do.
